questions.question: Which offset shape adds one scalar to each row of a \((2, 3)\) batch?
questions.explanation: \((2, 1)\) broadcasts across the three columns. Shape \((2,)\) conflicts with the trailing dimension \(3\).
optionFeedback: Broadcasting aligns trailing dimensions, so a length-two vector cannot match the trailing length-three axis. Add a singleton feature axis.
\((2, 1)\) broadcasts across the three columns. Shape \((2,)\) conflicts with the trailing dimension \(3\).
This has the axes reversed. Write one offset per row and repeat it across the three columns using shape \((2,1)\).
